title: Set a maximum price for WhatsApp marketing messages
summary: Set a maximum delivery price on WhatsApp marketing templates, compare estimated cost and reach, and adjust your cap by recipient country.
body_markdown:
You can now set the maximum Meta may charge for each delivered WhatsApp marketing message. Compare estimated cost and reach at different prices, then choose a cap for each template language and add country overrides for the markets you send to.


In the template editor, open **Pricing** and enable **Use maximum price** . Enter your cap per 1,000 deliveries in the displayed business-account currency, or select a price on the graph. Save and submit the draft to request the pricing change.


[Set up maximum pricing](https://bird.com/docs/guides/whatsapp/authoring-templates/marketing#setting-a-maximum-price) .
